Our office attended Radiance Pregnancy Care Center's open house in Beaufort to learn about their nonprofit and the work they are doing to support women at every stage of pregnancy.

The Radiance Pregnancy Care Center is celebrating 40 years of educating women across the Lowcountry and sharing the gospel with soon-to-be moms to uplift them in faith throughout their pregnancy journeys.

There are two very different approaches to public safety in America today. One coddles criminals. The other stands shoulder-to-shoulder with the men and women who show up to stop them.

We have never been confused about where we stand, and neither have the people of South Carolina.

Summerville is one of the fastest growing communities in South Carolina and public safety must keep pace.

When local leaders made it clear more officers were needed, we got to work. We helped secure $625,000 for the Town of Summerville Police Department through the U.S. Department of Justice's COPS Office Hiring Program, funding the addition of five new police officers to strengthen public safety in the community.

South Carolina is not Big Tech's personal power grid.

We're calling for a one-year moratorium on new data center construction in South Carolina, putting Big Tech on notice: South Carolina families will not foot the bill for their massive energy demands.

Our No Violent Criminals in the Federal Workforce Act bars anyone convicted of a violent crime from accepting or holding any position in federal civil service or working on federal contracts.

Other countries have done more to deliver justice for the victims of Jeffrey Epstein and his co-conspirators than our own government has.

We want everyone who participated, and everyone who helped cover it up, behind bars.

Hold the line.

Video

Every blacked-out name is a predator walking free. Every redaction is a choice to protect the guilty over the innocent.

If our justice system worked half as hard for victims as it does for predators, we would not be here. Who is being protected with these redactions and why?

The only names being redacted in the Epstein files should be those of victims. Anyone referenced as being involved with children or illegal activities should be named.

We introduced the AI Training Extension Act of 2025, a commonsense, bipartisan bill aimed at modernizing the federal workforce through expanded access to AI training.

This bill broadens AI education to include a wider range of federal employees, such as supervisors, managers, and frontline staff in data and technology roles.

Our office met with the President and VP of Bushy Park, an industrial complex home to a dozen companies including Newport News Shipbuilding and Leonardo DRS.

12 companies. 1,300 employees. Still growing.

Our job is to make sure the infrastructure keeps up. We are working to support funding for improved barge slips so Bushy Park can keep growing, keep hiring, and keep putting the Lowcountry on the map for skilled jobs, defense manufacturing, and industrial excellence.

South Carolina STRONG.

When we questioned former President Bill Clinton, his lawyer barely let him answer a single question.

So the question stands: do you think a young girl massaging a president is unusual? We sure do.

We will not stop until there is accountability and justice for every victim of Jeffrey Epstein.

Video

We won’t sit back while Jewish Americans are getting attacked in our own country and wait for the next tragedy.

We introduced the No Amnesty for Hamas Sympathizers Act, cutting off all immigration benefits and legal protections for individuals from Palestinian-controlled areas or those holding Palestinian Authority travel documents.

This should never happen in America. This bill slams the door shut and keeps terrorist sympathizers and antisemitic extremists out.

Americans are rightfully tired of seeing their tax dollars spent on wasteful experiments disguised as research while advancing a political agenda. 

We introduced the Transgender Research on Animals Now Stops and Money for Ideological Cruelty Eliminated Act, the TRANS MICE Act, to put an end to the use of taxpayer dollars for radical transgender-related experiments on animals.

➡️ Sexual Abuse of a Minor
➡️ Abusive Sexual Contact Against a Child

Department of War 🇺🇸 (@DeptofWar)

In honor of Armed Forces Day, we have unfurled an America’s 250th anniversary flag at the Pentagon.

We will always honor our warriors’ strength, sacrifice, and devotion to defending freedom.

Our office met with USCB Chancellor Al Panu, Executive Vice Chancellor Kim Dudas, and university leadership to discuss federal funding opportunities.

Beaufort County is growing fast, and USCB is growing right along with them. The university is educating the next generation of leaders who will shape this region for decades to come. Making sure they have the resources to keep up with demand is not optional. It is essential.

South Carolina STRONG.
